_comment: Each case starts from the scenario with the screen just shown (code 4821) and runs its steps in order: `args` after the setup command, `minutes_later` after the screen, and the expected `reply` ({setup}, {revoke}, {bind} and {grants} as the host spells them, new grant ids as gr-??????), or, with `items`, the screen shown again with that many items. Then the grants file holds the original grants plus `grants_added` (kind, pattern, allows, scope, expires_at and source; set_by is who applied, granted_at is when it was applied) and the original bindings plus `bindings_added`, and the proposals file holds `proposals_left` (proposal id: items).
